big_case.notes: An unpublished two-page Ninth Circuit memorandum affirming a Rooker-Feldman dismissal of a pro se section 1983 suit arising from one domestic-relations arbitration and an expired restraining order. Five advocacy-group amicus briefs show some interest in the parental-rights/private-arbitration theme, but both respondent groups waived, no response was called for, and the petition was denied at its first conference without a noted dissent. Low stakes beyond the parties.
